data.title: Fuel For The Trip
data.description: Come help us load up the tanks for our next big journey in the sky.

challenges.instruction: Fly a basket of sweet apples from Cloudville to Sunnyside, 3,500 km away. Each tank of fuel flies 500 km. Load enough tanks for the trip plus 1 spare tank, then press Fly.
Fly the mail bags from Starport to Moon Valley, 300 km away. Each tank of fuel flies 100 km. Load enough tanks for the trip plus 1 spare tank, then press Fly.
Fly a friendly bear plush from Breezy Bay to Pine Hill, 1,000 km away. Each tank of fuel flies 250 km. Load enough tanks for the trip plus 1 spare tank, then press Fly.
Fly the fresh bakery bread from River Town to Green Valley, 1,000 km away. Each tank of fuel flies 200 km. Load enough tanks for the trip plus 1 spare tank, then press Fly.
